item.title: Swish 1.13.3
item.description:
Swish 1.13.3

  • General compatibility with macOS 27 (Golden Gate).
  • Due to a bug on Apple’s side, the Menubar → Mission Control → Screens gesture currently does not work in macOS 27.
  • Restored tab support for Arc and added vertical tab support for Chrome.

Swish 1.13.2

  • Added tab support for UPDF.
  • Restored tab support for Dia and for Safari on macOS 26.2.
  • Improved Firefox tab support to respect scrollable tab bar. Snapping gestures still work outside the tab bar or by using the Super Modifier.
  • Fixed a bug where some windows could not be sent to another space.

Swish 1.13.1

  • Added tab support for Firefox since it now properly implements the Accessibility API.
  • Restored tab support for Orion browser in macOS 26.
  • Removed checkboxes and instead named and enabled all apps that support tab detection in Settings → Windows → Tabs as the list got too long.
  • Fixed a bug where gestures would not work on some dock icons.

Swish 1.13

  • General compatibility with macOS 26 (Tahoe) and a new Liquid Glass app icon.
  • Restored tab support for Safari 26.
  • Restored tab support for Chrome and Brave related to a recent change in Chromium. Unfortunately, tab support for Microsoft Edge cannot be restored.
  • Added tab support for Dia browser.
  • Fixed a bug where gestures would not work on a Catalyst app’s dock icon.
  • Fixed a bug where some windows could not be moved between spaces.
  • Fixed a bug where windows from applications with an additional "Script" menu could not be tiled natively.
  • Fixed a bug where windows from applications using the JUCE framework were not recognized properly.

Swish 1.12

  • Added Stage Manager auto-detection and a custom offset slider for its recent apps area.
  • Synced grid spacing when ‘Sequoia Window Tiling’ is enabled.
  • Improved window detection for apps that block the Accessibility API (e.g. Adobe and Affinity).
  • Improved speed of the ‘Minimize/Unminimize All’ menubar gesture.
  • Added Dock gesture support for apps that do not have a macOS app bundle ID.
  • Fixed a bug where windows would be re-snapped erroneously after exiting fullscreen mode.
  • Fixed a crash when interacting with unbundled symlinked applications launched via Terminal.

Swish 1.11

  • Added the option to use macOS Sequoia’s native window tiling for 2×2 snapping.
  • Even smoother live tooltip animation.
  • Disabled gestures on scrollable sliders in toolbars, e.g. in Music.app.
  • Fixed a bug where Swish would crash when minimizing its own settings window.
